summary: Reproduced the missing lm_head_is_tied attribute in the checked-out Gemma4Unified constructor and inherited first-forward path. The unified constructor now records the same tied-head condition as Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, including the CPU AMX exception, and its loader copies tied checkpoint embeddings into a materialized head when aliasing is unavailable. Added regression coverage using a small real Transformers Gemma4UnifiedConfig for tied and untied construction, tied and untied weight loading, numerical first forward, and GPU graph capture/replay.

remaining_limitations: The original google/gemma-4-12B-it startup was not exercised because its gated weights were not downloaded. Heavy decoder components were substituted in the regression while retaining the actual SGLang unified constructor, loader, inherited forward, real small Gemma4UnifiedConfig, and GPU graph machinery. Multi-process pipeline-parallel execution and a physical CPU AMX host were not available; their branch behavior is covered structurally, including the materialized tied-head load path. No native code changed.
